name: Cardiology
description: Specializes in diagnosing and treating diseases and disorders of the heart and blood vessels.

name: Pediatrics
description: Provides medical care for infants children and adolescents.

name: Orthopedics
description: Focuses on injuries and diseases of the bodys musculoskeletal system.

name: Neurology
description: Deals with disorders of the nervous system including the brain and spinal cord.

name: Dermatology
description: Focuses on the medical and surgical treatment of skin hair and nail disorders.

name: General
description: Focuses on acute, self-limiting and short-term illnesses using targeted medications.
